target_customer: Independent tourism businesses and group travel organisers that need online presence, direct bookings and payments in many currencies; consumers via The Guide
problem: Independent tour and activity operators in emerging markets struggle to be discovered, take direct bookings and accept cross-border payments.
business_model: Payments and booking platform with transaction fees for tourism businesses

founders.name: Mark Datta
founders.background_notes: YC page: worked in finance and at travel and fintech startups before founding Tab. Employers not named.

technical_complexity.rationale: Multi-currency payments and booking for travel needs payment integrations and compliance, standard fintech engineering with some hard parts for a very small team.

defensibility.rationale: Payments plus booking tooling for operators could be copied by larger travel and payments platforms; its edge is focus on emerging-market independent operators.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition or incumbent copy was found; the company remains independent with a team of 9 per the YC page.

market_need_then: Not documented in sources dated around 2015. The YC page contrasts Tab with traditional booking sites and bland review listings.

branding.domain_note: Uses tab.travel on the .travel TLD, not tab.com; business site at business.tab.travel.

identity.voice_and_tone: Promotional site says it is backed by the investors behind Airbnb, OpenAI, Dropbox and Stripe.

brand_strength.rationale: No press about the brand found; searches for Tab return several unrelated Tab companies, including a bill-splitting app and an AI assistant.

pivots.from: Consumer travel discovery with friend and expert recommendations (The Guide)
pivots.to: Payments and booking platform for independent tourism operators and group travel
pivots.why: Not stated; both descriptions appear on the YC page and the business site. Date unknown.

outcome_analysis: Tab is a London company from YC Winter 2015 that now sells payments and booking tools to independent tourism operators across 40 countries per its own listings. No exit, shutdown or layoff was found. Funding figures conflict across aggregators and no press release confirms any round, so the funding path and the outcome cannot be judged. The company appears small but alive.
notes: Funding unverified, aggregators only: Seedtable and Bouncewatch date a YC seed to August or September 2015; CB Insights shows 2.15M dollars over 3 rounds with a 1.9M dollar seed in 2024-01 while StartupIntros shows 230K in 2024-03; Prospeo says none. No primary source, so no round is recorded. Competitors: YC page names none and no dated 2015 coverage was found. Not the same as the SF AI assistant named Tab or the Tab expense app.
